Controlled Mock Application Form

Structural test fixture. Labels are deliberately generic (slot-referenced), not personal-information labels — the information content (L-INFO) is owed by the team per the §10/ASM-002 inventory and is not invented here. With no approved form-field→attribute mapping (G-12/G-13) and no OCR-populated record (S-6), DOCURA will detect every field but map, fill, and match nothing — the honest, safe default.
